mediaServices._note: Each service becomes its own section on the Media page, anchored at #slug. The homepage and the Media card grid link straight to it. Visual mode picks one of the five approved section treatments.
headline: Nine Services.
One Team
mediaServices.body: Every one of these is explained in full below. Pick the one you came for.

items.title: Google Ads
items.outcome: Capture demand from people already searching.
items.why: People searching for your service are already showing intent. The goal is to turn that demand into calls, forms, bookings or purchases.
does: Google Ads account/campaign setup or restructuring
Search / Performance Max / local campaign management where appropriate

items.title: Meta Ads
items.outcome: Create and convert demand on Facebook + Instagram.
items.why: Meta works differently from search: the creative has to earn attention before the visitor is actively looking for you.
does: Lead generation or website conversion campaigns
items.imageAlt: KLIP edit suite with a colour-grading panel and timeline

items.title: SEO
items.why: SEO helps your business appear when people research your services without paying for every click.

items.title: GEO / AI Search
items.outcome: Improve how your business is understood by AI and answer engines.
items.why: GEO complements SEO. It improves the clarity and usefulness of the information AI systems can interpret; it does not guarantee citations.

items.title: Social Media
items.outcome: Run a consistent content system, not random posting.
items.why: KLIP can connect strategy and production, so the client is not left with a calendar but no content to publish.
items.imageAlt: Content production on the KLIP studio floor

items.title: Branding
items.outcome: Make the business recognizable and consistent.
items.why: Branding should make the business easier to recognize, remember and trust across every channel.
does: Logo refinement or identity system where scoped

items.title: Website Design
items.outcome: Build a site that explains, converts and can be found.
items.why: A website should not just look good. It should help visitors understand the offer, trust the business and take the next step.

items.title: AI Solutions
items.outcome: Use automation and AI to reduce repetitive work.
items.why: The value is not 'AI for AI's sake'; it is saving time, improving consistency and making useful processes easier.

items.title: Content Strategy
items.outcome: Decide what to create, for whom and why.
items.why: Content strategy connects production to business goals so the team is not posting without a reason.
